items.h: D CORE Colorful Labels for Cable Tags
Dimension: Sheet Size: A4 Paper, 210mm x 297mm (Tags 30pcs/sheet)

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The D CORE Wire Tags Labels Sticker PVC Self Adhesive A4 Rose Red is a premium-quality cable labeling solution designed for professional and industrial use. With its vibrant rose red color, these labels ensure quick and easy identification of wires, making cable management more efficient in complex environments like server racks, networking systems, and electrical panels.


Each A4 sheet (210x297mm) contains 30 pre-cut wire tags, providing a practical and organized labeling system. Made from high-grade PVC material, these labels are durable, waterproof, oil-resistant, tear-resistant, and heat-resistant—perfect for both indoor and outdoor applications.


The strong self-adhesive backing ensures the labels stay firmly attached to cables without peeling. These wire tags support both manual writing and printing, making them highly versatile for technicians and IT professionals.


Key Features


  • High-quality PVC self-adhesive wire labels
  • A4 sheet size (210x297mm)
  • 30 tags per sheet (26mm × 84mm each)
  • Eye-catching rose red color for easy identification
  • Waterproof, oil-proof, heat-resistant & tear-resistant
  • Strong adhesive for long-lasting use
  • Compatible with inkjet & laser printers
  • Writable with marker or pen
